definition: Unique annotation record identifier.
annotation_rule: Use the assigned ANN_R#_### identifier; never reuse an ID.

definition: Registered asset being annotated.
annotation_rule: Use one registered asset ID per annotation; do not embed private source filenames.

definition: Identifier for the person recording the annotation.
annotation_rule: Use the assigned pseudonymous annotator identifier.

definition: Version of the annotation taxonomy used.
annotation_rule: Use BF_ANNOT_V1.1 for new annotations; preserve historical versions in locked data.

definition: Review round number.
annotation_rule: Record the annotation round without changing earlier locked rows.

definition: Date and time the annotation was completed.
annotation_rule: Enter only when captured by the annotation process; otherwise leave blank.

definition: Apparent camera height relative to the subject.
annotation_rule: Classify from visible perspective cues; use unclear when visible cues do not support a confident label.

definition: Apparent vertical camera angle.
annotation_rule: Record upward, level, or downward from visible convergence and viewpoint cues.

allowed_values: full_body | three_quarter | half_body | close_up | other | unclear
definition: Extent of the subject included in the frame.
annotation_rule: Classify the visible crop, not the intended composition.

allowed_values: front | three_quarter_left | profile_left | back | profile_right | three_quarter_right | unclear
definition: Direction the torso/body faces relative to the camera.
annotation_rule: Left and right are the subject's anatomical left and right.

allowed_values: front | three_quarter_left | profile_left | back | profile_right | three_quarter_right | unclear | not_visible
definition: Direction the head faces relative to the camera.
annotation_rule: Use anatomical left/right. Three-quarter means both sides of the face remain meaningfully visible; profile is approximately side-on with little or no far-side facial structure. Do not apply a strict angular threshold; use not_visible when the head cannot be seen.

allowed_values: upright | left | right | forward | backward | unclear
definition: Visible lean of the body axis.
annotation_rule: Describe the observed axis only; do not evaluate posture quality.

allowed_values: standing | seated | kneeling | crouching | lying | other | unclear
definition: Primary visible support posture.
annotation_rule: Choose the closest visible stance; standing may remain inferable under some crops when visible body configuration is sufficient.

allowed_values: balanced | left_dominant | right_dominant | forward | backward | unclear | not_applicable
definition: Visible distribution of support or load.
annotation_rule: Requires visible lower-body or support evidence. Without it use unclear; anatomical left/right applies.

definition: Relative visible height of the shoulders.
annotation_rule: Compare the subject's anatomical shoulders; use not_visible when comparison is impossible because they cannot be seen.

definition: How much of the head is visible.
annotation_rule: Judge only visibility in the image, including crop and occlusion.

definition: How much of the torso is visible.
annotation_rule: Fully visible means the complete taxonomy-required torso region is represented in-frame. Partially visible means some torso is visible but crop or meaningful occlusion removes part of the torso region.

definition: How much of the waist and hip region is visible.
annotation_rule: Judge only visibility in the image, including crop and occlusion.

definition: How much of the legs is visible.
annotation_rule: Use not_applicable only when legs genuinely do not apply to the depicted subject presentation.

definition: How much of the feet is visible.
annotation_rule: Judge only visibility; use not_applicable only when the field genuinely does not apply.

definition: Overall degree to which relevant body regions are obscured.
annotation_rule: Assess visible obstruction or cropping without inferring hidden content.

allowed_values: front | left | right | overhead | back | diffuse | mixed | unclear
definition: Dominant apparent direction of illumination.
annotation_rule: Use diffuse when no directional source is visible and mixed when multiple directions are evident.

allowed_values: close_fitting | regular | loose | mixed | unclear | not_visible
definition: Visible relationship of clothing to the body outline.
annotation_rule: Describe visible fit only; do not infer size, comfort, or intent.

allowed_values: neutral | left | right | unclear | not_visible | not_applicable
definition: Visible rotation of the torso relative to a neutral orientation.
annotation_rule: Annotate when the torso is visible enough; otherwise use unclear, not_visible, or not_applicable as defined.

allowed_values: neutral | left | right | unclear | not_visible | not_applicable
definition: Visible rotation of the pelvis relative to a neutral orientation.
annotation_rule: Annotate when the pelvis is visible enough; anatomical left/right applies.

definition: Visible state of the subject's anatomical left knee.
annotation_rule: Classify only when applicable and sufficiently visible.

definition: Visible state of the subject's anatomical right knee.
annotation_rule: Classify only when applicable and sufficiently visible.

allowed_values: forward | inward | outward | lateral | unclear | not_visible | not_applicable
definition: Direction of the subject's anatomical left foot.
annotation_rule: Classify from visible evidence only; inward/outward are relative to the subject.

allowed_values: forward | inward | outward | lateral | unclear | not_visible | not_applicable
definition: Direction of the subject's anatomical right foot.
annotation_rule: Classify from visible evidence only; inward/outward are relative to the subject.

definition: Visible state of the subject's anatomical left elbow.
annotation_rule: Classify only when applicable and sufficiently visible.

definition: Visible state of the subject's anatomical right elbow.
annotation_rule: Classify only when applicable and sufficiently visible.

allowed_values: none | self_occlusion | clothing | object | crop | another_person | mixed | unclear | not_applicable
definition: Primary visible cause of occlusion.
annotation_rule: Use none when no occlusion is present and not_applicable only when the field genuinely does not apply.

definition: Annotator confidence in the completed record.
annotation_rule: Use 1 (low), 2, 3, or 4 (high) after reviewing all fields.

definition: Flag indicating whether a second review is requested.
annotation_rule: Choose yes when uncertainty, ambiguity, or inconsistency warrants review; otherwise choose no.

definition: Optional factual annotation notes.
annotation_rule: Record concise visible evidence or ambiguity; do not add appearance evaluation or inferred intent.
